content.text:
The British International School (BIS) Hanoi scores above the global average in the IB Diploma and well above England's averages at IGCSE.

**IB Diploma: Class of 2026 (latest)**
- **Average score:**
35.11 points, significantly above the global average of 30.88 points.
The VnExpress report gives a slightly different figure:
the 68 students in the Class of 2026 achieved an average score of 35.15

.
- **Track record:**
This is the ninth consecutive year that the school has beaten the worldwide average.
- **Perfect scores:**
Two students, Gia Khanh and Seojung, achieved a perfect score of 45 points.
- **Top scorers:**
More than 1 in 7 students of the graduating class achieved a 40+ point score

.
- **Bilingual Diploma:**
62.9 percent of students were awarded the IB Bilingual Diploma.
- **Core points:** The cohort also had
the school's highest-ever average Core Points score of 1.92

. VnExpress reports 1.94.

**IB Diploma: Class of 2025**
-
The average was 33.24, against a global average of 30.58.
One student scored 44 out of a possible 45 points
9.7% of the 2025 graduating class scored 40 points or more.

**IGCSE: 2025 (latest detailed figures I found)**
-
46% of grades were A* or A (England: 23%), and 85% were A–C (England: 55%).
35% of students achieved 5 or more A*/A grades, and 6 students got only A* and A grades.
- Two Year 11 students, Dakyung and Ayoung,
earned the "Top in the World" award for IGCSE Mathematics.
- For comparison, in 2024
45% of grades were A* to A and 86% were A* to C

.

**IGCSE: 2026**
The school says
students achieved outstanding IGCSE results in 2026, significantly outperforming UK averages

. However, I couldn't find the actual percentages in my searches. The full article, "BIS Hanoi students achieve exceptional results in IGCSE examinations 2026," is on the school's news page.

All these figures come from the school or its sponsored press coverage. When comparing schools, keep in mind that the averages depend on who sits the exams and how many students are in the year group.
